protocol.experiment: C dimension and write-time protected-basis comparison
protocol.supervision: tail-4-token autoregressive CE of the window's own dropped-block fact lines under the candidate pool; no QA answer ever enters a gradient step
protocol.basis: full-space damaged gradients; optional kept-gradient projection; SVD then truncate
protocol.selection_rule: windows picked on stage-1 coverage (best/worst gRho), not QA
protocol.metrics: new_recovery = full∧¬d0∧trained; d0_harmed = d0∧full harmed; net = new_recovery - d0_harmed; both teacher-forced exact and greedy-generation EM recorded
protocol.reader_evaluation: eval; exact mixed-mode and RNG restoration; full-memory integrity check
protocol.supervision_leakage: raw write-time fact statements only; benchmark QA is evaluation-only
protocol.protection: basis construction only; no hinge or additional training loss

projection.projection: hard orthogonal projection in full down.weight space before SVD
projection.protection_selection: up to 40 encoded kept latest-owner facts with finite 0<=D0 answer CE<=2; sorted key
projection.objective: unchanged C summed tail-4 CE gradients; no protection penalty

protocol.gradient_reduction: sum of per-line mean tail4 CE gradients
protocol.reported_loss_reduction: mean over supervision lines; identical to original C
